articles.author: Avi Kapoor
articles.headline: Nasdaq Falls Over 100 Points As Oil Prices Surge: Investor Sentiment Edges Lower, Greed Index Remains In ‘Fear’ Zone
articles.summary: CNN Fear & Greed index showed slight decline in market sentiment as crude oil prices rose. GEV & PEGA stocks fell, while T stock gained.
articles._summary: The CNN Money Fear and Greed index showed a slight decline in the overall market sentiment, while the index remained in the “Fear” zone on Wednesday. U.S. stocks settled mostly lower on Wednesday, with the Nasdaq Composite falling more than 100 points during the session amid a rise in crude oil prices. Oil prices climbed as the U.S. carried out its 11th consecutive night of strikes on Iran, broadening its targets and stoking fears over the flow of crude through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.author: Namrata Sen
articles.headline: Elon Musk Says Tesla's Spending Spree Is the 'Fastest Industrial Scale-Up Since World War II' as 2026 Shapes Up To Be a 'Massive CapEx Year'
articles.summary: Elon Musk calls Tesla's growth the fastest since World War II as CFO Vaibhav Taneja signals a massive 2026 CapEx push.
articles._summary: During the Q2 earnings call on Wednesday, Taneja expressed the company’s readiness to spend aggressively on vehicles, autonomy, and robotics, anticipating strong returns. He marked 2026 as a “massive CapEx year” for Tesla. Tesla’s reported a record capital expenditure (CapEx) of $5.79 billion for the second quarter, representing a 142% year-over-year increase from the prior year. At the same time, its total GAAP operating expenses climbed 47% year-over-year to $4.35 billion in the second quarter of 2026.
articles._zh_headline: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 表示，特斯拉的支出热潮是“二战以来最快的工业规模扩张”，2026 年将成为“大规模资本支出年”
articles._zh_summary: 在周三的第二季度财报电话会议上，塔内贾表示，该公司准备在车辆、自动驾驶和机器人技术上大举投资，并预计将获得强劲回报。他将 2026 年标记为特斯拉的“大规模资本支出年”。特斯拉报告第二季度资本支出 (CapEx) 达到创纪录的 57.9 亿美元，同比增长 142%。与此同时，2026 年第二季度其 GAAP 运营支出总额同比增长 47% 至 43.5 亿美元。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Intel CFO David Zinsner Said Supply Would Improve 'Through the Rest of the Year' — Q2 Earnings Will Test That
articles.summary: Intel reports Q2 Thursday as investors watch for signs AI-related supply constraints that hurt Q1 revenue have started to ease.
articles._summary: During the first-quarter earnings call in April, CEO Lip-Bu Tan said demand continued to outpace supply across Intel’s businesses, particularly for Xeon server CPUs, even as the company expanded factory output. The company CFO, David Zinsner, said first-quarter revenue “would have been meaningfully higher” if more supply had been available, and expected supply to improve in the second quarter and continue increasing through the rest of the year.
articles._zh_headline: 英特尔首席财务官 David Zinsner 表示，供应量将在“今年剩余时间内”有所改善——第二季度收益将检验这一点
articles._zh_summary: 在 4 月份的第一季度财报电话会议上，首席执行官 Lip-Bu Tan 表示，尽管英特尔扩大了工厂产量，但英特尔各业务部门的需求仍然超过供应，尤其是至强服务器 CPU。该公司首席财务官 David Zinsner 表示，如果供应量增加，第一季度的收入“将会显着提高”，并预计第二季度的供应量将有所改善，并在今年剩余时间内继续增加。

articles.headline: John Paulson says we are in the early stages of a long-term bull market for gold
articles.summary: He said demand for bullion continues to broaden, led by central banks that have been adding to their reserves alongside growing private-sector interest.
articles._summary: John Paulson, the hedge fund manager who made billions betting against the U.S. housing market before turning bullish on gold, said he believes the precious metal is only in the early stages of a long-term rally. "I do think we're in the beginnings or the early stages of a long-term bull market for gold," Paulson said on CNBC's "The Exchange" Wednesday. "As people lose faith in paper currencies, gold as an alternative will continue to grow." Paulson, whose wager against subprime mortgages became one of the most profitable trades in Wall Street history, shifted his focus to gold in 2009, arguing that the unprecedented fiscal and monetary stimulus following the financial crisis would ultimately weaken the U.S. dollar. Since then, gold prices have roughly quadrupled, topping the $5,000 threshold before pulling back. The billionaire investor said demand for bullion continues to broaden, led by central banks that have been adding to their reserves alongside growing private-sector interest.
articles._zh_headline: 约翰·保尔森表示，我们正处于黄金长期牛市的早期阶段
articles._zh_summary: 对冲基金经理约翰·保尔森(John Paulson)在转而看好黄金之前，曾在美国房地产市场上做空数十亿美元，他表示，他认为这种贵金属仅处于长期反弹的早期阶段。保尔森周三在 CNBC 的《The Exchange》节目中表示：“我确实认为，我们正处于黄金长期牛市的开始或早期阶段。” “随着人们对纸币失去信心，黄金作为替代品将继续增长。”保尔森对次级抵押贷款的押注成为华尔街历史上最赚钱的交易之一，他在 2009 年将注意力转向黄金，认为金融危机后前所未有的财政和货币刺激措施最终将削弱美元。此后，金价大约上涨了四倍，突破了 5,000 美元的关口，然后又回落。这位亿万富翁投资者表示，在各国央行不断增加储备以及私营部门兴趣不断增长的带动下，对黄金的需求持续扩大。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Scott Bessent Says Open Source AI Not 'Open Season' on American Intellectual Property, Warns Chinese AI Firms of Sanctions
articles.summary: Treasury's Scott Bessent warns Chinese AI firms could face sanctions, Entity List over AI distillation tied to US IP theft.
articles._summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Wednesday warned that Chinese artificial intelligence companies could face sanctions and Entity List designations if they use “industrial-scale distillation attacks” that cross into intellectual property theft. In a post on X, Bessent said President Donald Trump ‘s administration supports open-source AI and the innovation it unlocks but added that “open source is not open season on American IP.”
articles._zh_headline: 斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 称开源人工智能并非美国知识产权的“开放季节”，警告中国人工智能公司不要实施制裁
articles._zh_summary: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特周三警告说，如果中国人工智能公司使用涉及知识产权盗窃的“工业规模蒸馏攻击”，它们可能会面临制裁和实体清单指定。 Bessent 在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府支持开源人工智能及其所带来的创新，但他补充说，“开源并不是美国知识产权的开放季节。”

articles.author: Aniket Verma
articles.headline: Elon Musk's Tesla Held on to Bitcoin Stockpile in Q2 Despite $112 Million in Paper Losses
articles.summary: Tesla Inc. recorded paper losses on its Bitcoin holdings for the third straight quarter, but did not sell any, according to its earnings release on Wednesday, July 22.
articles._summary: As of March 31, the EV giant held $674 million in digital assets, down 45% year-over-year and 14.24% from the previous quarter. Tesla reported $112 million in paper losses on cryptocurrency investments, marking three straight quarters of red ink. The Elon Musk -led company does not publish a breakdown of its cryptocurrency holdings. Instead, all investments are grouped under the “digital assets” line item. On-chain analytics firm Arkham Intelligence reports that its stockpile consists solely of Bitcoin.
articles._zh_headline: 尽管账面亏损 1.12 亿美元，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的特斯拉在第二季度仍持有比特币库存
articles._zh_summary: 截至3月31日，这家电动汽车巨头持有6.74亿美元的数字资产，同比下降45%，环比下降14.24%。特斯拉公布的加密货币投资账面亏损为 1.12 亿美元，连续三个季度出现亏损。这家埃隆·马斯克领导的公司没有公布其加密货币持有量的详细信息。相反，所有投资都分组在“数字资产”行项目下。链上分析公司 Arkham Intelligence 报告称，其库存仅由比特币组成。
